achievements.description: Awarded for uncovering every truth that had gone untold, and thus completing the full Akademy curriculum.
Awarded for completing the prologue.
Awarded for completing Chapter 1, "The Meager."
Awarded for completing Chapter 2, "The Manipulative & the Subservient."
Awarded for completing Chapter 3, "The Valiant."
Awarded for completing Chapter 4, "In the Name of Love."
Awarded for reaching level 30 or above with five party members.
Awarded for reaching level 40 or above with five party members.
Awarded for reaching level 50 with Ramza.
Awarded for taking on an errand at a tavern.
Awarded for earning the title of Master Treasure Hunter.
Awarded for earning the title of Master Adventurer.
Awarded for achieving great success in every errand.
Awarded for recruiting a soldier from the warriors' guild.
Awarded for using the services of a poachers' den.
Awarded for having ten different items produced at a poachers' den that cannot be purchased from outfitters.
Awarded for changing the job of a party member.
Awarded for learning an ability with a party member.
Awarded for using an action ability with a party member during battle.
Awarded for learning all the abilities of a job with one party member.
Awarded for learning all the abilities of every job with one party member.
Awarded for knocking an enemy away with "Counter Tackle."
Awarded for removing an ally's status ailment or restored their HP five times using "Throw Items."
Awarded for destroying enemy equipment using Arts of War abilities five times.
Awarded for inflicting damage on enemies five times using Aim abilities.
Awarded for simultaneously inflicting damage on two or more enemies with "Shockwave" five times.
Awarded for dealing the felling blow to five enemies with the White Magick ability "Holy."
Awarded for inflicting damage on an enemy with a Black Magick ability targeted on a tile, and doing so five times.
Awarded for successfully using "Teleport" five times.
Awarded for summoning five different espers in battle.
Awarded for successfully using "Poach" five times.
Awarded for successfully using "Entice" five times.
Awarded for inflicting status ailments on enemies five times with Mystic Arts abilities.
Awarded for inflicting damage on enemies using five different Geomancy abilities.
Awarded for inflicting damage on enemies with "Jump" five times.
Awarded for utilizing the hidden power of five different katana with "Iaido."
Awarded for inflicting damage on enemies five times with "Throw."
Awarded for inflicting damage on three or more enemies at once with Arithmeticks abilities without harming an ally.
Awarded for utilizing the power of five different Bardsong abilities.
Awarded for inflicting a status ailment on three or more enemies at once with "Forbidden Dance" five times.
Awarded for using "Mimic" five times.
Awarded for obtaining a buried item during battle.
Awarded for acquiring an ability from a crystal.
Awarded for mounting a chocobo.
Awarded for hatching a creature egg.
Awarded for reading about five different people in the Encyclopedia section of the Chronicle.
Awarded for reading the Scriptures of Germonique to the end in the Reading Materials section of the Chronicle.
Awarded for watching the scene "Seekers of the Stone" in the Events section of the Chronicle.
Awarded for watching the scene "The Metallic Sphere."
Awarded for completing all levels of Midlight's Deep.
